rows.label: Concept
rows.text: **Integration** runs differentiation backwards. An **anti-derivative** satisfies F′ = f, and ∫f dx = F + C — the **+C** restores the family constants destroyed by differentiation (two anti-derivatives differ by a constant). The **basic table** mirrors the derivative table (power rule reversed, ln|x|, eˣ, −cos x, tan⁻¹x, sin⁻¹x), and **linearity** integrates term by term (NEB 2023: 3x² + 2x − 1 → x³ + x² − x + C).…

rows.label: Formula
rows.text: - ∫xⁿdx = xⁿ⁺¹/(n+1) + C (n ≠ −1); ∫dx/x = ln|x| + C; ∫eˣdx = eˣ + C - ∫f(g)g′dx = ∫f(u)du; ∫f′/f dx = ln|f| + C - ∫u dv = uv − ∫v du (LIATE for u)

rows.label: Derivation
rows.text: ## 1. Topic Introduction — Differentiation in Reverse **Anti-derivatives and integration**: the basic integral table, **integration by substitution**, and **integration by parts** — running the derivative machinery backwards.  ·  ## 2. Fundamental Concepts ### 2.1 Anti-derivative and the indefinite integral - **F is an anti-derivative of f** ⟺ F′ = f. **∫f(x)dx = F(x) + C** — the whole family, since constants differentiate to 0. **Uniqueness theorem:** two anti-derivatives of the same f differ by a constant.…

rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Spot f' inside: substitute. Product of unlike types: parts with LIATE. ln x alone: parts with u = ln x. Always + C; always check by differentiating.

rows.label: Board question
rows.text: **NEB 2023 (verified PYQ): Evaluate ∫(3x² + 2x − 1)dx. (3m)** — **Linearity:** split into three integrals with constants carried: ∫3x²dx + ∫2x dx + ∫(−1)dx. **Power rule reversed term by term:** ∫3x²dx = 3·x³/3 = **x³**; ∫2x dx = 2·x²/2 = **x²**; ∫(−1)dx = **−x**.…  ·  **NEB-style (3m): Evaluate ∫2x·e^{x²}dx.** — **Spot the composite:** e^{x²} is e^u with u = x², and the integrand contains u′ = 2x as a factor — the substitution licence is complete. **Transform:** let u = x², du = 2x dx; the integral becomes ∫eᵘdu. **Integrate:** eᵘ + C.…

rows.label: Hints
rows.text: Verify your answer by differentiating it back - the check is fast and catches sign slips in parts computations.

rows.label: Quick concepts
rows.text: Integration is differentiation reversed: substitution reverses the chain rule, parts reverses the product rule - every method is a derivative theorem read backwards.

rows.label: Key points
rows.text: Anti-derivative: F' = f; indefinite integral is the family F + C (two anti-derivatives differ by a constant). Basic table: x^(n+1)/(n+1) (n != -1), ln|x|, e^x, a^x/ln a, -cos x, sin x, tan x, tan^-1 x, sin^-1 x. Linearity: term by term.…

rows.label: Universal facts
rows.text: Odometers integrate speedometers: distance is the anti-derivative of velocity - the + C is where the trip started.

rows.label: More practice
rows.text: **NEB-style (3m): Evaluate ∫x·ln x dx.** — **Method selection:** a product of unlike types (algebraic × logarithmic) ⟹ **integration by parts**. **LIATE ordering:** Log ranks before Algebraic ⟹ choose **u = ln x** (differentiate the logarithm) and **dv = x dx** (integrate the power).…  ·  **NEB-style (6m): Evaluate ∫x²·eˣ dx using integration by parts (applied twice), and verify your answer.** — **First parts (LIATE: Algebraic before Exponential ⟹ u = x², dv = eˣdx):** du = 2x dx, v = eˣ ⟹ ∫x²eˣdx = x²eˣ − ∫2x·eˣdx.…  ·  **NEB-style (5m): Evaluate ∫dx/(x·ln x).** — **Spot the nested structure:** the integrand is (1/ln x)·(1/x) — and 1/x is exactly the derivative of ln x. **Substitute:** u = ln x, du = dx/x ⟹ the integral becomes ∫du/u. **Integrate:** ln|u| + C.…

rows.label: Study notes
rows.text: ## 3. Scientific Definitions | Term | Scientific meaning | Example | |---|---|---| | **Anti-derivative** | F′ = f | x² for 2x | | **+C** | The constant family | all solutions | | **Substitution** | Chain rule reversed | u = g(x) | | **Parts** | Product rule reversed | ∫u dv = uv − ∫v du |  ·  ## 4. Detailed Explanation ### 4.1 Why + C is not decoration - Differentiation destroys constants; integration must restore the whole family. Initial conditions (a point the curve passes through) pin C — the constant is where physical initial data enters calculus.…  ·  ## 5. Comparison Tables **Method selector** | Integrand shape | Method | |---|---| | f(ax + b) | linear substitution | | f′(x)/f(x) | u = f: ln\|f\| | | fⁿ·f′ | power substitution | | xⁿ·(exp/trig) | parts (u = xⁿ) | | ln x, tan⁻¹x alone | parts (u = the function) | | eˣ·sin x | parts twice + solve |

rows.text: **NEB-style (6m): Evaluate ∫eˣ·sin x dx using integration by parts twice and solving the resulting equation.** — **Let I = ∫eˣ sin x dx.** **First parts** (LIATE: Trig before Exponential ⟹ u = sin x, dv = eˣdx): I = eˣ sin x − ∫eˣ cos x dx.…  ·  **NEB-style (5m): Evaluate ∫(2x + 3)/(x² + 3x + 5) dx.** — **Recognise the f′/f pattern:** the denominator's derivative is d/dx(x² + 3x + 5) = **2x + 3** — exactly the numerator.…  ·  Evaluate ∫(3x² + 2x − 1)dx.

rows.label: More ideas
rows.text: Limit to remember: derivative f'(x) = lim_{h→0} [f(x+h) − f(x)]/h = tangent slope; rules: sum, product, quotient, chain.  ·  ## 6. Common Confusions **Forgetting + C:** the indefinite integral is a family; omitting C loses a mark every time. **∫dx/x = ln|x|:** the absolute value is part of the answer (domain symmetry). **Parts u-choice:** differentiate the LIATE-earlier factor — choosing u = eˣ in ∫xeˣdx loops forever.  ·  ## 7. Exam Application **NEB 2023 (verified PYQ): Evaluate ∫(3x² + 2x − 1)dx. (3m)** — **Linearity + power rule reversed:** ∫3x²dx = x³; ∫2x dx = x²; ∫(−1)dx = −x. **Result: x³ + x² − x + C.** (Check: d/dx(x³ + x² − x + C) = 3x² + 2x − 1 ✓.)

rows.label: More ideas
rows.text: **NEB-style (3m): Evaluate ∫2x·e^{x²}dx.** — **Substitution:** u = x², du = 2x dx ⟹ ∫eᵘdu = eᵘ + C ⟹ **e^{x²} + C**. The integrand contains the inner function's derivative exactly — the substitution licence is complete.  ·  **NEB-style (3m): Evaluate ∫x·ln x dx.** — **Parts** (LIATE: Log before Algebraic ⟹ u = ln x, dv = x dx): du = dx/x, v = x²/2. ∫x ln x dx = (x²/2)ln x − ∫(x²/2)(1/x)dx = (x²/2)ln x − (1/2)∫x dx = **(x²/2)ln x − x²/4 + C**.  ·  ## 8. Deep Conceptual — The Substitution Licence and Its Limits - **The licence:** substitution u = g(x) is legal exactly when the integrand contains g′(x)dx — i.e. the integrand has the shape f(g(x))·g′(x) (up to a constant). The constant is absorbable (multiply by 1/a), the *absence* is fatal.…
